401913767.venue: Skip Chappelle Court in Memorial Gymnasium
rundown: Quakers beat Black Bears 77-50 at Skip Chappelle Court in Memorial Gymnasium in Orono, ME. Quakers led 33-25 at the half and never looked back. The 4th quarter decided it: Quakers won it 23-10. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 78%).
Leading the way — Quakers: Katie Collins 23 pts; Mataya Gayle 5 ast, 6 reb. Black Bears: Kaliyah Sain 19 pts; Maddie Fitzpatrick 5 ast, 11 reb.
Where Quakers won it: they shot 51% to 39%, shot 24% from three to 23% and won the boards 31-30.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 22, 11:26 AM ET. It had Quakers 63% and Black Bears 37%, projecting Quakers 71.8 – Black Bears 67.5 (139.3 total, Quakers by 4.3).

Final: Quakers 77 – Black Bears 50. Right winner: it had Quakers at 63%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Quakers came in with a 9% above average attack and a 5% stingier than average defense (5-1, 75 scored and 55.8 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 167 and 168 games of evidence. Projected to score 71.8, they scored 77 (+5.2 points, 7% over); projected to allow 67.5, they allowed 50 (−17.5 points, 26% under).

Black Bears came in with a league-average attack and a 2% leakier than average defense (4-1, 73.4 scored and 67.4 allowed a game over 5 games), worth about 162 and 161 games of evidence. Projected to score 67.5, they scored 50 (−17.5 points, 26% under); projected to allow 71.8, they allowed 77 (+5.2 points, 7% over).

The bigger miss was Black Bears' scoring (-17.5 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 127 against 139.3 projected (-12.3), about the 19th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14).

Margin: Quakers by 27 against Quakers by 4.3 projected, about the 4th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±13).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.887 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -21.4 points. It counts toward NCAAW scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 895 graded NCAAW games the algo now scales scoring ×0.972 and gives home teams +1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Quakers attack ×0.997, defense ×0.981 (6 games); Black Bears attack ×1.010, defense ×1.008 (6 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 22.7 points), no bet.
